title: Schylling NeeDoh Dream Drop - Sensory Squeeze Toy with Dreamy Smooth Squeeze - 3" Tall - Color May Vary (Pack of 1)

reviews.title: Loved by adults and students
reviews.body: I love these and so do my students ! I think the color that arrives is random as I didn't select a color and got a pink one.  Which I didn't mind but just something to be aware of. The material is different from other squishy "balls" these are a bit sturdier yet soft and slowly go back to their shape. The only down side is that the glitter makes its way to the top of the material and ends up coming off but it's not a super fine glitter to where it's everywhere. If you don't mind a few specs here and there than you would love this squishy toy! Great foray sped classroom!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 3, 2025
reviews.author: Aline

reviews.title: These are amazing!
reviews.body: It's really remarkable how calming these are!  Really helps cope with stress and oversimulation.  We take at least one with us all over now.It's hard to explain the feel, but they are stiffer when cold and softer when warmed up, even just from enough use after a while.  Very satisfying either way, with a nice resistance level.  Not overly bulging like some stress balls are shown (those freak me out just looking at them) but still very flexible and decently stretchy, and they return gently to form instead of a fast bounce-back.The drop shape is perfect, it fits right in the curve of your palm, and the surface is smooth but plenty grippy.  Can collect lint and debris, but that's easy enough to just wash off with some water.  They've held up against some pretty intense stretching and wringing when we were agrevated, too.The colors and sparkle of them are very pretty, which I think also helps the stress-relief, though I note the few extra flakes of glitter on the outer surface of them came off basically right away.  Not that it's a big deal, and I don't know why they put any glitter on the ouside, but it didn't work.  The splash-shaped stands are cute, and are a different soft rubbery material, not gel filled like the drops.Wish you could select color, but we later found elsewhere a three-pack with one of each color, and even at an extra discount!  Now we can have them handy various places.

reviews.title: Absolutely LOVE!!! 🥰
reviews.body: It sits right in front of me at work. The stress ball I never knew i needed!!!! You get a random color and i was lucky enough to get my favorite color. Shortly after bringing it to work and playing with it i didscovered the little droplets at the bottom is a base so you can peel it off and have a rounder drop to need to your anxietie's content, and then put it on the base so it doesnt roll away. The material is amazing. It doesnt pick up all the debris that gooey ones do. I can water cleener and even risked using a lysol wipe and it didnt damage it (wouldnt recomend doing that often because im sure it will cause damage if youre not careful). I find myself squeezing it without even remember grabbing it because i keep it right in front of me. It helps when im stress, overstimmed, and just straight bored. I bought some of the other types from this brand as a christmas gift for all my favorite coworkers and we all love them. Will likely buy another as a backup and another for home. Great for all ages as its not so soft that it would explode and it softens up a little as warm it up in your hands. Its taken a lot of abuse and yet shows no signs of damage or wear. If youre reading this, than you need this product! Just buy it already, you'll thank yourself for it!!! 100 out of 100, best thing I've bought on Amazon!!!!

reviews.author: GJ

reviews.title: Not the same as the NiceBerg!
reviews.body: Are you looking for the Nice berg but it’s sold out and assume they all will feel the same, so no biggie? WRONG.Follow me on this ramble if you need a highly specific description.I work at a thrift shop and was sorting through a donation box that was clearly a kids junk drawer. I was grabbing things out on auto pilot work mode not paying too much attention because it was full of broken crayons, random legos, a half eaten lollypop, a decapitated Barbie. You get the idea.I then pulled out this blue square thing. And I specifically remember stopping and staring at it for a while because it caught me off guard on how nice it felt in my hand. I couldn’t stop squishing it. The satisfaction was top tier. I knew then and there I had to have one of my own!Unfortunately I knew nothing about them, so I bought the drop thinking oh this must be the same thing, just smaller and cheaper. Perfect!Oh boy was I wrong. It’s stiff and weird. like trying to squish old hard taffy in your hands.  And makes my hands ache after squishing it because it’s not very malleable .I thought to myself there is no way this was the same as the magical blue square I had touched a few weeks ago. Maybe my memory was bad, and it wasn’t as great as i remembered. So it ended up in my own junk drawer. And I forgot about it for months.However the thought kept nagging at me though to just buy the nice berg. I had to know. Was it truly different or just my imagination.Well, let me tell you It absolutely was different! Side by side, the drop is stiff and weird, the nice berg is just pure mind numbing bliss with no sore hands after.In conclusionSkip buying this, trust me. pay the extra and get the nice berg, not cube or drop or whatever other name. The Berg! Unless of course you’re seeking a very challenging squish that’s harder, then you’ll love the drop.- Also I use the nice berg a lot during therapy because when im talking about difficult things and I’m anxious I need to do something with my hands. And this is perfect. Not sticky or messy like putty or slime, but similar in satisfaction.
